<h3 id="widget_realloc">widget_Realloc</h3>
<p>Resizes a widget control "<strong>handle</strong>" to contain <strong>n</strong> entries, allowing it to be expanded or condensed. Doing this unnecessarily can lead to RAM fragmentation. It is much better to allocate widget controls once with the desired number of entries.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Realloc(handle, n);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">handle</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">n</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">New number of entries.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  New handle to widget control.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-443-1" name="__codelineno-443-1" href="#__codelineno-443-1"></a><span class="n">var</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">;</span>
<a id="__codelineno-443-2" name="__codelineno-443-2" href="#__codelineno-443-2"></a><span class="nl">hndl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-443-3" name="__codelineno-443-3" href="#__codelineno-443-3"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="n">ILed1RAM</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-443-4" name="__codelineno-443-4" href="#__codelineno-443-4"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed2RAM</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-443-5" name="__codelineno-443-5" href="#__codelineno-443-5"></a><span class="n">widget_Add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ILed3RAM</span><span class="p">);</span>
<a id="__codelineno-443-6" name="__codelineno-443-6" href="#__codelineno-443-6"></a><span class="nl">hndl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Realloc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="c1">// Reallocate widget control</span>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_enable">widget_Enable</h3>
<p>Enable an item in a widget control. This function requires that a widget control has been created with the <a href="#widget_create">widget_Create()</a> function.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Enable(hndl, index);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>

<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  True if index was ok and function was successful.</p>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_setattributes">widget_SetAttributes</h3>
<p>This function SETS one or more bits in the widget flags field of a widget control entry. "<strong>value</strong>" refers to various bits in the widget control entry (see widget attribute flags). A '1' bit in the "value" field SETS the respective bit in the widget flags field of the widget control entry.</p>
<p>Widget attribute flags to be used and maintained by widgets and touch processing:</p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_TOUCH_ENABLE</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x8000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to disable touch for this image, <br>(default=1 for movie, 0 for image).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INTERNAL</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x4000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Internal use only (force redraw on next write).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INITIALISED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x2000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Flag when ‘base gauge needle, etc.’ is done</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_UNDRAW_ONLY</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x1000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to prevent draw of new needle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INPUT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0800</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set if this is an input (Used only with the IDE).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_FLASH</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0400</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">set if this is a flash based widget.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_RESERVED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x03c0</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">bits 9-6 reserved.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_SetAttributes(hndl, index, value);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">value</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">The word to be written to the entry.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  TRUE if successful, return value usually ignored.</p>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_clearattributes">widget_ClearAttributes</h3>
<p>This function CLEARS one or more bits in the widget flags field of an image control entry. "value" refers to various bits in the widget control entry (see widget attribute flags). A '1' bit in the "value" field CLEARS the respective bit in the widget flags field of the image control entry.</p>
<p>Widget attribute flags to be used and maintained by widgets and touch processing:</p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>

<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
<th style="text-align: left;"></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_TOUCH_ENABLE</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x8000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to disable touch for this image, <br>(default=1 for movie, 0 for image).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INTERNAL</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x4000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Internal use only (force redraw on next write).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INITIALISED</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x2000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Flag when ‘base gauge needle, etc.’ is done</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_UNDRAW_ONLY</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x1000</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set to prevent draw of new needle.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_INPUT</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0800</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Set if this is an input (Used only with the IDE).</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_FLASH</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">0x0400</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">set if this is a flash based widget.</td>
</tr>

<td style="text-align: center;">WIDGET_F_RESERVED</td>

<h3 class="page-break" id="widget_touched">widget_Touched</h3>
<p>This function requires that a widget control has been created with the <a href="#widget_create">widget_Create()</a> function.</p>
<p>Returns index of the widget touched or returns -1 if no widget was touched.</p>
<p>If index is passed as <strong>-1</strong> or <strong>ALL</strong> the function tests all widgets.</p>
<p><strong><em>Syntax</em></strong>:   <code>widget_Touched(hndl, index);</code></p>
<div class="md-typeset__scrollwrap"><div class="md-typeset__table"><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;">Arguments</th>
<th style="text-align: left;">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">hndl</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Handle of the widget control.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">index</td>
<td style="text-align: left;">Index of element in the widget control.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></div></div>
<p><strong><em>Returns</em></strong>:  -1 if image not touched, or returns index.</p>
<p><strong><em>Example</em></strong></p>
<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><code tabindex="0"><a id="__codelineno-450-1" name="__codelineno-450-1" href="#__codelineno-450-1"></a><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">==</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">TOUCH_PRESSED</span><span class="p">)</span>
<a id="__codelineno-450-2" name="__codelineno-450-2" href="#__codelineno-450-2"></a><span class="w">    </span><span class="nl">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">widget_Touched</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">hndl</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">ALL</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">     </span><span class="c1">//scan widget list, looking for a touch</span>
<a id="__codelineno-450-3" name="__codelineno-450-3" href="#__codelineno-450-3"></a><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
<a id="__codelineno-450-4" name="__codelineno-450-4" href="#__codelineno-450-4"></a><span class="w">        </span><span class="n">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">);</span><span class="w">                      </span><span class="c1">// print index of widget touched</span>
<a id="__codelineno-450-5" name="__codelineno-450-5" href="#__codelineno-450-5"></a><span class="w">    </span><span class="n">endif</span>
<a id="__codelineno-450-6" name="__codelineno-450-6" href="#__codelineno-450-6"></a><span class="n">endif</span>
</code></pre></div>
